question: The famous movie "3 idiots" is based on the novel " Five Point Someone" which is written by Indian author ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chetan Bhagat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chetan Bhagat is the author of the novel "Five Point Someone" which was adapted into the movie "3 Idiots".**
 
• Chetan Bhagat is a popular Indian author known for his best-selling novels such as "One Night @ the Call Center", "2 States" and "Half Girlfriend".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Khushwant Singh** was an Indian author and journalist known for his works such as** "Train to Pakistan", "The Company of Women" and "Delhi: A Novel".**
 
• ** Durjoy Datta** is an Indian author known for his romantic novels such as "**Of Course, I Love You", "Till the Last Breath" and "Our Impossible Love".**
 
• **Novoneel Chakraborty** is an Indian author known for his psychological thrillers such as "**The Stranger Trilogy", "Black Suits You" and "Cheaters".**
